title: One Model, Many Modes: Evolving System Prompt Ensembles for Creative Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Preference-aligned LLMs can exhibit mode collapse, concentrating their output distributions around a narrow set of high-reward responses. This limits creative generation, which requires quality, novelty, and diversity. Existing test-time methods often emphasize diversity, giving less attention to whether individual responses are both high-quality and novel. This distinction matters in practical use, where users may seek a single compelling, original response. We formalize creative generation as a multi-objective distributional optimization problem and introduce SEPO, a training-free framework for System Prompt Ensemble Optimization. The framework combines prompt evolution with greedy max-min selection to identify behaviorally distinct system prompts under a quality constraint, then uniformly samples one prompt per response at inference time. Across four creative generation tasks with increasing quality requirements and three open-weigh

translated_title: 一个模型，多种模式：为创造性生成演化系统提示词集成
translated_abstract: 偏好对齐的大语言模型（LLM）可能出现模式坍缩现象，即其输出分布集中于一小部分高奖励响应附近。这限制了创造性生成，因为创造性生成需要同时具备质量、新颖性和多样性。现有的测试时方法往往强调多样性，而对单个响应是否兼具高质量与新颖性关注较少。这一区别在实际应用中很重要，因为用户可能只想要一条令人信服的、原创的响应。我们将创造性生成形式化为一个多目标分布优化问题，并引入 SEPO——一个免训练的系统提示词集成优化框架。该框架将提示词演化与贪心最大-最小选择相结合，在质量约束下识别行为上各不相同的系统提示词，然后在推理时为每个响应均匀采样一个提示词。在四个质量要求逐步提高的创造性生成任务以及三个开源权重模型上（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出免训练框架 SEPO，通过演化系统提示词集成并结合质量约束下的贪心最大-最小选择来缓解偏好对齐大语言模型的模式坍缩，从而生成兼具高质量、新颖性与多样性的创造性内容。
en_tdlr: SEPO is a training-free framework that evolves ensembles of behaviorally distinct system prompts via greedy max-min selection under a quality constraint, mitigating mode collapse in preference-aligned LLMs to enable creative generation that is simultaneously high-quality, novel, and diverse.
